prayerExcerpt.en-US: "God be praised Who has allowed this, that I may serve Him better than I have heretofore done."
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: "Bendito seja Deus, que permitiu isto, para que eu O sirva melhor do que até agora o fiz."

meta.face: A French princess of about forty with a pale, smooth complexion and a LONG face that is fuller in its LOWER half — a very HIGH, smooth forehead, a long, straight nose with a softly rounded tip, SMALL, HEAVY-LIDDED, rather close-set blue-grey eyes under faint, fine brows, a LONG upper lip, a small, closed, gently pursed mouth, soft, full lower cheeks and a rounded chin; hair hidden by the wimple; a quiet, patient, inward gaze lowered to the crucifix.
meta.basis: The panel portrait on Wikipedia, of unknown author, shows a long, pale face with a high forehead, small heavy-lidded eyes, a long upper lip and a small pursed mouth under a dark hood; the card follows its structure. Her habit is described by the Catholic Encyclopedia (grey, with scarlet scapular and white mantle), and the book says she was buried in the royal crown over the habit, hence the crown on the veil. She had a curvature of the spine; the half-length pose leaves it out, as the brief asks.
